proposal.reason: Main change is in the IB network backend and proxy path: connection handshake/state machine, QoS (TC/SL/FIFO TC), ECE/GRH/FLID handling, receive completion sizing, and per-device MR registration cache/reuse in net_ib and net transport code. Added gin because GIN-specific IB paths were substantively changed to validate/normalize traffic class and use the new IB connect/abort behavior, which is a distinct GIN networking surface.
